theme: Modern Minimalist (Clean White + Deep Forest Emerald Accents)

elderly_friendly_rules.min_tap_target: 48px x 48px minimum height/width for buttons and input fields
elderly_friendly_rules.font_scale: Base body text min 16px/18px, section headings 24px+, high contrast against background (APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1+)
elderly_friendly_rules.input_padding: p-4 or py-3.5 px-4 for generous touch target
elderly_friendly_rules.icon_size: min 24px for actionable icons with visible text labels next to them
elderly_friendly_rules.visual_cues: Always pair icons with clear text labels (e.g. 'Tampilkan Kata Sandi', 'Ganti Akun')
elderly_friendly_rules.feedback: Clear toast notifications using Sonner, high-visibility loading spinners and full screen/modal status messages

layout_and_spacing.header_style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FAFBF9]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E5E7EB] px-4 py-3.5

login_page.identifier_field: Flexible identifier input (Nomor HP / Email / Username)
login_page.password_field: Password input with prominent show/hide eye toggle (data-testid='password-toggle')
login_page.forgot_password_link: Link 'Lupa kata sandi? Hubungi administrator' opening modal/dialog
login_page.self_reset_password: Mandiri Reset Password for Peserta using Tanggal Lahir + Nomor HP verification
login_page.activation_registration_buttons: Two high-visibility secondary CTAs: 'Aktivasi Akun (QR)' & 'Daftar Baru (Scan QR)'

qr_pendaftaran_and_aktivasi.qr_generator_display: Client render server-side generated & cached QR code for public registration
qr_pendaftaran_and_aktivasi.qr_activation_flow: Scan/Input code flow to activate new Peserta account
qr_pendaftaran_and_aktivasi.download_print_qr: Button to copy link or save QR image for print/display

top_bar.user_profile: Avatar image + User full name + Current role tag on top-right

role_cards.title: Admin (Pengelola Sistem)
role_cards.description: Kelola pengguna, buat & atur jadwal pengajian, kelola QR code publik, dan lihat laporan presensi lengkap.

role_cards.title: Pengurus (Petugas Sesi)
role_cards.description: Buka sesi presensi pengajian, verifikasi kehadiran jamaah, dan pantau rekap kehadiran harian.

role_cards.title: Peserta / Jamaah
role_cards.description: Lakukan presensi cepat via QR code, cek jadwal pengajian terkini, dan lihat riwayat kehadiran Anda.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use clean Tailwind CSS with custom colors defined in color scale (#0D5C3A for primary brand).
Ensure input fields have minimum height of 48px and font size of text-base for elderly-friendliness.
Place clear data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as listed above.
Implement tab/modal switcher for self-service password reset with Date of Birth + Phone.
Use Lucide icons (Eye, EyeOff, QrCode, UserCheck, Shield, Users, LogOut, RefreshCw, Key, ChevronRight).
Use Sonner for toast notifications on success/error events.
Keep header sticky with ganti akun on top-left and user avatar + name on top-right for role dashboard.
